title: Emergency Supplies
description: Riese is preparing emergency supplies to protect some reckless adventurers from getting in trouble on Dragonspine...

mainQuestExcel.title: Emergency Supplies
mainQuestExcel.description: Riese is preparing emergency supplies to protect some reckless adventurers from getting in trouble on Dragonspine...

dialogs.text: Traveler! Wonderful timing. Could you do me a favor?
What do you need?
As you've no doubt seen, the conditions up here are horrendous. Even experienced adventurers would not dare to claim that they can handle all that Dragonspine can throw at them.
I have orders from the Acting Grand Master to stand guard here and warn all citizens not to go up the mountain.
However, while I have been able to persuade many citizens not to do so, those adventurers...
I'm sure you know what I mean when I say that there's no use trying to convince them. They just want to go up that mountain.
I've lost count of the number of matters I've had to resolve involving the adventurers... But they just keep coming anyway, and their ranks never thin.
Trying to manage them all is an impossible task... As such, I've decided to prepare some supplies for them in designated spots on Dragonspine.
In this way, those adventurers who have suffered a reverse and are preparing to turn back will have more opportunities to extricate themselves from the mountain.
However, if some reckless fool drunk on their good fortune were to get too far up, then they'd only have themselves to rely on...
So, could you help bring these supplies up the mountain?
Leave it up to me.
I shall be counting on you, then. *sigh* If only those adventurers had as good a sword-arm and as sensible a head on their shoulders as you do...
I've marked three locations out on your map. You simply have to place <color=#00E1FFFF>one serving of Ham</color> at each place.
*sigh* I wish those adventurers had a little more self-awareness...
Will they be of any use?
Whether they will or not... It's better to have them than not.
In such terrible conditions as the ones we have on this mountain, the more supplies we have, the better. All told, I'm counting on your help.

Have you placed all the supplies?
They're all where they need to be.
That's wonderful. I can rest easy now.

Come to think of it, your clothes seem a little thin, too. Is this the latest fashion in Mondstadt or something?
Whatever the case, please take these as a token of my thanks, and go put on some extra layers.
